africaFirst.subtitle: We didn't copy a Western ecommerce model and ship it here. Jovi Mall is built from the ground up for mobile-dominant, WhatsApp-native, data-conscious African consumers and businesses.

features.mobileDesc: Every pixel optimized for the phones Africans actually use — from entry-level Infinix to flagship Samsung.
features.whatsappDesc: No downloads, no logins. Commerce where 2+ billion people already spend their day.
features.dataDesc: Built to work on 2G, 3G, and spotty connections. Commerce that doesn't stop when the signal drops.

trust.subtitle: Enterprise infrastructure built for the speed and scale of African commerce — without the enterprise complexity.

features.revenueDesc: Every transaction creates value for vendors, agencies, and agents simultaneously — a true shared economy.
features.scaleDesc: Multi-city, multi-currency, and multi-language ready. Expand from Lagos to Nairobi to Accra without rebuilding.
